records.name: Rml::WidgetScroll
records.representation: Definition exists only in Source/Core/WidgetScroll.h. Native ElementScroll owns its widgets, timers and listeners; this forward site declares no separately callable public operation.

records.name: Rml::ElementScroll
records.representation: ElementScroll(element) owns a distinct actual native component; Element.getElementScroll() is the canonical borrowed component. Operations use the original native algorithms. Owned release/GC teardown detaches widget listeners before native children die; host destruction and shutdown invalidate every facade and clear visible host roots. Non-DOM children remain host-owned. No raw element pointer is exported and unchanged queries scan no peers.

records.name: Rml::PropertiesIteratorView
records.representation: Element.iterateLocalProperties(filter=null) consumes the actual native iterator in one entry and returns independent ordered [name, Property] snapshots. Native AtEnd, increment and dereference complete before V8 wrapping; later style changes cannot invalidate copied results. No borrowed iterator lvalue or property reference escapes into JS.

records.name: Rml::PropertiesIteratorView::PropertiesIteratorView
records.representation: Actual native UniquePtr backend construction, move construction and move assignment execute in the native probe; position and property references transfer, replaced owners are deleted once, and moved-from destruction does not delete the transferred owner. The JS contract consumes the original iterator into independent ordered property snapshots in one native entry with zero callbacks. No invalidatable iterator or borrowed reference escapes into JS.
